meta.title: dsh-mm-resilience
meta.description: Every image is parsed once when it first enters the session, archived with a tag, and never re-sent as image bytes in later requests — root-cause prevention of multimodal session wedges. Configurable pixel budget (oversized images auto-downscaled by the native pipeline) and per-message image-count cap; originals re-viewable on demand (mm_view_image).
